physicalNotes: No radius or mass of Helix Nebula is recorded: it is an extended nebula, and its package frames it at 1.571 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), a presentation value.

sources.position: ESO ESO WFI · optical detail image and publisher astrometry; registration retained in the observation recipe (https://cdn.eso.org/images/original/eso0907a.tif); catalogue reference helix-registered-images
sources.distance: Benedict et al. (2009), HST parallaxes of planetary nebula nuclei (https://arxiv.org/abs/0909.4281); catalogue reference benedict-2009: 216 pc (-12/+14); Adopted published trigonometric parallax; not a fitted image scale.
sources.properMotion: Zero: the nebula is held at its catalogued position; no motion across the sky is applied.
